meaning: Stronger verification retains the complete checked public project, including composition bindings and every emitted artifact; each artifact receives an explicit kind of evidence rather than being dropped from the denominator.
selection: Construct from the registered immutable public project plan using the whole-project artifact view. Preserve the registered composition plan and its exact source/ontology/argument/native-target bindings. Retain existing node views and prior evidence requirements; add composition requirements without duplicates.
partition: Every emitted file belongs to exactly one disjoint category: selected TypeScript module, declared generated composition JavaScript behavior, or preserved composition data/provenance. Category identity comes from checked planner ownership, not an arbitrary caller extension. Reject absent, duplicate or unaccounted artifacts. Record complete and per-category counts.
native: Compile all TypeScript modules under the existing strict pinned compiler. Parse every generated JavaScript module with Node syntax checking, without importing or executing it. Observe TypeScript and JavaScript import/export surfaces independently through the pinned compiler AST, with JavaScript type checking explicitly not claimed. Preserve every supporting artifact byte through exact source replay and final workspace/output currentness.
composition: Check composition source preservation by exact replay and source/selection round trip. Check selected Calculation binding inventory against the fresh checked binding plan and observed native modules. These are source/binding checks, not runtime behavior proof. Composition behavior controls remain required and not_evaluable until independently executed.
formalization: The existing Lean finite structural predicates retain their exact meaning and list. Round-trip observation preserves the full source graph, including composition source, ontology and core bindings. Do not label this as a new theorem about composition execution or SFOL.
dependency_rule: JavaScript syntax, composition preservation and selected binding checks depend on replay/source/tool/workspace currentness as applicable. Late source, artifact, observer, configuration or tool drift invalidates dependent passes. All unmet checks remain in the report; any failure yields fail, otherwise any unmet requirement yields incomplete.
compatibility: No legacy default change, source-profile relaxation, provider call, target mutation or stronger CLI success bypass. Application-layout target support remains explicit work if not yet selected by the executor. Preserve all 40 prior compiler source pins and add only this definition.
validation: positive native composition compilation, JavaScript parsing/AST observation, Lean round trip and exact replay
complete source/binding/inventory fields and requirement counts
late JavaScript and supporting-file mutation invalidates native/binding evidence
domain-only verification remains supported with unchanged unmet semantic checks
